provenance.note: Always Free compute allowances for Ampere A1 and AMD micro shapes.
Live per-shape billing classification. Preferred over this snapshot wherever OCI returns it.
Source of the live limit values. The limit names recorded below are display hints only, used to decide which of a tenancy's many limits to highlight.

assumptions: These allowances are tenancy-wide, not per-region.
A stopped instance still occupies its shape allocation; only termination releases it.
Allowances published by Oracle can change without notice, which is why this file records a verification date and why live OCI evidence takes precedence.

The `service_limits` and `network_limits` entries are presentation hints, never billing policy. A name Oracle renames or removes simply stops matching, which changes what is highlighted and never what is permitted.
unknown_behaviour: Any resource class absent from `compute_allowances` is classified Unknown and therefore blocked in strict mode. This file never widens eligibility beyond what it explicitly lists.

compute_allowances.description: Ampere A1 flexible shape, pooled across all instances in the tenancy.
AMD micro shape, limited by instance count rather than cores.
